summary: Coolant hose fitting spray near high voltage pump motor.
narrative: Worker observed high coolant line pressure causing fitting spray near secondary cooling loop motor.

summary: Secondary coolant line fitting spraying fluid under high pressure.
narrative: Secondary coolant fitting ruptured slightly and sprayed coolant across walkway in Site Bay 2.

summary: Hydraulic pump relief valve failure causing high pressure surge.
narrative: Pressure surge in main hydraulic pump exceeded 3500 PSI due to stuck relief valve.

summary: Hydraulic fluid pooling around main reservoir tank.
narrative: Hydraulic fluid leak found under reservoir drain plug on Unit 3.

summary: Generator housing loose mounting bolt causing severe vibration.
narrative: High vibration frequency recorded on generator frame during start sequence.

summary: Generator excitation coil housing loose and vibrating heavily.
narrative: Excessive vibration during generator testing near main breaker.

summary: Valve seal weeping acidic solution onto floor flange.
narrative: Chemical flange leak detected on line V-101 in processing area.

summary: Air compressor manifold relief valve venting continuously.
narrative: Relief valve stuck open on air compressor creating high decibel noise hazard.

summary: Coolant temperature spike triggering thermal alarm.
narrative: Coolant temperature exceeded 200 F due to blocked heat exchanger fins.

summary: Arc flash reported on 480V distribution panel.
narrative: Loose lug on distribution breaker caused brief arc flash during switching.
